question: For the 15 top-30 community foundations with no public grant-payment page (SVCF, FFTC, GKCCF, Columbus, NYCT, Boston, Marin, CFNJ, San Diego, CF Greater Memphis, Tulsa, Tampa Bay, East Bay, Omaha, GiveWell), what rail pays DAF grants in 2025-26? Use grant letters and remittance notes that nonprofits post publicly, 990 Schedule O, Chariot, Bill.com and REPAY customer pages, and the foundations' nonprofit FAQs
conclusion_affected: Rail map for community foundations; size of the check-paid DAF grant pool; Chariot and AP-vendor footprint
rationale: The top-30 census found 10 own-ACH, 2 third-party (Chariot at SPMF, Bill.com at CFGA), 2 check-only (CCT, and NHCF through Citizens Checkmint), 1 unverified and 15 with nothing public. No PayPal Grant Payments or Ren ACH use was found at any of them

question: Who builds DonorSphere and which community foundations run it? Its front-end config names tenants ghcf, pgh, delcf, gmw and jfnnj. Is the Pittsburgh Foundation (now on Blackbaud NetCommunity) migrating to it, and who is behind the support domain pgfundconnection.com?
conclusion_affected: Portal-vendor map for community foundations; a new portal vendor at two top-25 foundations
rationale: GHCF runs DonorSphere ('Powered by DonorSphere®'). The shared config also carries a 'pgh' tenant and GA id, but Pittsburgh's live donor pages are Blackbaud NetCommunity. No page read names the vendor

question: How many community foundations have moved to NPact Foundation Cloud plus Blackbaud Financial Edge NXT and REPAY (the GWCF stack, live 2026-09-21)? Do San Diego and Tulsa (also on spectrumportal.net) pay grants through REPAY? Check spectrumportal.net tenants linked from foundation sites, NPact and REPAY customer pages, and Blackbaud payments pages
conclusion_affected: Blackbaud/NPact share of community-foundation ledgers and payment rails; REPAY as an unmapped AP-style grant rail
rationale: GWCF names Foundation Cloud Community Portal, Financial Edge NXT and Blackbaud REPAY on its own pages. The San Diego and Tulsa portals sit on the same spectrumportal.net host family. REPAY is not yet in the repo's provider map

question: Which of Ren's '25+ donor-advised fund programs' does one Ren for Charities ACH enrolment cover? Do any Ren-owned iPhi community-foundation clients (Minneapolis, Cleveland, Greater Memphis, Louisville) pay through Ren ACH, given that SPMF (also on iPhi) chose Chariot? Use sponsor charity pages, publicly posted grant letters and the 'Foundation' filter that Ren's help articles describe in the charity grant report
conclusion_affected: A2 Ren X1/X4; whether Ren's ACH network reaches beyond its national sponsors
rationale: Ren's help centre (article dated July 2026) claims ACH enrolment 'from 25+ donor-advised fund programs at once' but names none. AEF is the only sponsor confirmation. RCF says funds are 'delivered electronically or by check'. BofA CGF's guide (modified Feb 2026) still describes checks

question: Watch Chicago Community Trust for a change of layer. Does the Give Interactive cct tenant (live, with CCT's Okta SSO client 'cct-prod-okta'; sandbox and staging certificates renewed 2026-09-01) gain a donor-facing link? Does donorportal.cct.org stop showing 'Powered by GiftingNetwork'? Does CCT's DAF grant rail move off mailed checks? Re-check quarterly and read CCT's FYE 9/2026 990 when it is filed (expected mid-2027)
conclusion_affected: Give vs GiftingNetwork at a top-2 community foundation
